text:
emma: quick PSA from the mobile sample app QA: cancelling a Retrofit suspend request that streams data sometimes leaves the next request stuck on Pixel devices when behind our corp VPN. anyone seen this pattern? :thinking_face:
rafael: hmm, is this with OkHttp 5.x or 4.x? and are you using the SDK-provided OkHttpClient or a custom one?
emma: SDK default client, we upgraded to OkHttp 5 a few weeks ago. repro is much easier on Pixel 8, less on emulator.
tanya: interesting. pattern? are you doing a raw ResponseBody read and cancelling mid-stream?
emma: yes - sample app fetches a large NDJSON stream; we cancel the coroutine if user navigates away. sometimes next fetch stalls for ~15-25s. snippet:
```kotlin
// suspend in sample app
val call = api.streamBig()
coroutineContext.job.invokeOnCompletion { if (it is CancellationException) call.cancel() }
return call.string()
```
rafael: that invokeOnCompletion idea is good but maybe too ad-hoc in sampleapps. Could be HTTP/2 stream state + VPN NAT that delays FIN. Have you tried connectionPool.evictAll() as a repro?
emma: evictAll reduced frequency but didn't eliminate. disabling keep-alives fixed it but perf is awful.
tanya: pragmatic SDK change: expose builder flag like autoCancelOnCoroutineCancel = true and provide a Kotlin suspend wrapper that wires call.cancel() on coroutine cancellation. That way sampleapp can opt-in and we can document behavior.
rafael: agree. also add a short note in onboarding docs about Pixel+VPN quirk and recommended opt-in for streaming endpoints.
dev-bot: Issue created: #6420 "OkHttp stream cancel -> next request stall on Android behind VPN"
emma: i'll draft PR in the SDK that adds: 1) suspend extension helper (AutoCancelableCall.await()) 2) Builder flag 3) sampleapp example and onboarding doc blurb.
tanya: add a unit/instrumented test that cancels and fires a follow-up request to catch regression. include Pixel 7/8 in matrix.
rafael: when you open PR, tag eng-ml for perf regression on throughput. if opt-in has no perf delta, consider turning default on in next minor.
dev-bot: CI presubmit queued for pr/1389 (draft)
emma: PR link (draft): https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/1389 - includes helper and docs. adding logs to the issue. will follow up. :raised_hands:
